info.name: GraphQL Node API
info.description:
Complete collection for the GraphQL Node API.

**Before you start:**
1. Run `docker compose up -d && npm run db:setup && npm run dev`
2. Import this file into Postman
3. Select the **GraphQL Node — Local** environment
4. Run **🔐 Login** first — the `jwtToken` cookie will be set automatically
